newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Foul end to offending rooster on Irish island.
newsitem.headline: Foul end to offending rooster on Irish island.

text.p: The Irish island of Achill will no longer resound to the crowing of 'Cailleach', the rooster at the centre of a legal tussle which caused its owner to be jailed last year.
The cockerel, whose loud crowing angered neighbours in the western Irish community and provoked a high court action, has met its end, Irish media reported on Thursday.
Marauding dogs were blamed for the rooster's demise, much to the unhappiness of its owner, a 62-year old mother of three, who was jailed for three weeks after refusing to get rid of the bird.
Moira Gallagher eventually won the right to keep the offending rooster at the end of the 1996 court action.
